title: Prevalence of Hazing and Bullying Incidents in Schools
what_it_is: Prevalence of Hazing and Bullying Incidents in Schools

sections.label: Bullying incidents and school measures
sections.summary: Reported bullying in 2019 was about two per 1,000 primary and five per 1,000 secondary students, and schools take educative, preventive and intervention measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The number of bullying incidents reported in 2019 was about two incidents per 1,000 primary students and five incidents per 1,000 secondary students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Schools monitor the cyber environment to the best of their abilities, taking both educative, preventive and intervention measures to address any bullying incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: When schools come across incidents of hurtful behaviour online, they take immediate action to investigate the incident, carry out appropriate disciplinary actions and provide counselling support for the students involved.

sections.label: Character in student leader selection
sections.summary: Character is a key consideration in selecting student leaders and helpers for camps, and those who do wrong are removed and disciplined.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Character is a key consideration in the selection process of student leaders and other student helpers for camps.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Camp activities are supervised by teachers, and student leaders and helpers are removed from their leadership positions and disciplined if there is wrongdoing.

sections.label: Disciplinary inquiry and consent teaching
sections.summary: Disciplinary committees conduct inquiries and can impose penalties from corrective work to expulsion, and MOE was asked about teaching consent younger.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: When there are reported incidents, the disciplinary committee teachers will conduct a disciplinary inquiry.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: They will pair disciplinary measures with counselling, if necessary, and, if there is a need for disciplinary action, they can take a range of penalties, for instance, from corrective work orders to suspension and, if the student perpetrator is a source of threat and danger to other students, they can consider expulsion, if necessary.

sentences.speaker: Dr Shahira Abdullah (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In light of the recent Ngee Ann Polytechnic case in which male students were urinated on and which a male student came out to say that it was just mindless fun and it was something consensual, would MOE consider teaching consent to youths at a younger age so that they can be better protected from bullying as well?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There is no place for degrading behaviour in our schools and IHLs, even if the students were to find it fun.
